claims.title: Distributed universal proof composition causes the observed rank-35 direct-propagation wall before semantic collapse
claims.statement: In the tested standard-7x6 deadline-clause recurrence, ranks 40 through 36 complete while rank 35 first remains unclosed at universal antichain conjunction. The exact distributed realization forms Cartesian candidate products before normalization; recorded supports include move-width products of 573270600 and 58748277 candidates. Rank 35 has exactly 1709 support vectors, and the predecessor-closed clause carrier is already qualified by C4-R0073/C4-R0074. High-rank abstract residual-shaped projections are orders of magnitude smaller than fine ownership boundaries, but are not legal-q censuses because exact cardinality and alternating-history realizability were not enforced. Therefore the observed wall is a scoped representation/composition-layer explosion before semantic/value collapse.
guards: scope is the tested standard-7x6 direct deadline-clause recurrence
abstract residual-shaped projections are not legal-q class censuses
finding does not establish empty-root solution or existence of a compact exact projection

claims.title: Compact clause-to-value controllable predecessor is the next missing closure seam
claims.statement: A compact realizability-preserving controllable-predecessor operation is needed to project predecessor-closed clause/proof structure into residual/q-value bounds before universal proof alternatives are fully distributed. C4-R0075 localizes the need, while C4-R0043 and C4-R0069 independently describe the predecessor/composition and observation-relative controllable-predecessor sides of the same seam. The existence, exact form, realizability contract and root-scale economics of this operator remain unproved.
guards: must preserve legal realizability rather than arbitrary residual recombination
must preserve first-win stopping, support and quantified opponent semantics
must not treat abstract residual projections as legal q without cardinality/history qualification
